text:
alex: FYI planning rollout for billing-service chart 3.1.0 to eu-west in ~20m. This includes a CRD schema bump and an offline migration job (billing-migrate). Deploy-bot preflight says job missing. Thoughts?

maria: If migration is small, run job manually then canary. If risky, pin to 3.0.x and backport the fix.

devin: Migration is idempotent per README. I vote manual migration + 5% canary then 30m observation.

ops-jen: We need a rollback script and DB restore plan in release notes. Also add admission webhook check for CRD compatibility.

deploy-bot: [preflight] missing Job/billing-migrate in namespace production-eu-west. To proceed: `kubectl apply -f migrations/billing-migrate-v1.yaml` or set `--set migration.enabled=true`

alex: I'll apply the job and tail logs. Plan: 1) apply migration, 2) run smoke locally against staging, 3) canary 5% then promote. Rollback: helm rollback to 3.0.6, restore snapshot only if corruption detected.

maria: Canary values: `replicaCount:1`, `routing.canaryWeight:5`, `image.digest` pinned. Add metric thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 400ms.

devin: Also add healthcheck for migration side-effects (missing fields).

alex: Applying job now:
```
kubectl apply -f migrations/billing-migrate-v1.yaml -n production-eu-west
kubectl logs -f job/billing-migrate -n production-eu-west
```

deploy-bot: Job started: job/billing-migrate. Monitoring.

alex: Migration completed: 3 failures retried, final status success. 4.2k rows processed.

deploy-bot: Preflight re-check: OK. Starting canary helm upgrade with overrides.

deploy-bot: `helm upgrade billing-service charts/billing-3.1.0 --namespace production-eu-west --set routing.canaryWeight=5 --set replicaCount=1 --reuse-values`

ops-jen: QA will run smoke suite in 10m. Alerts set.

maria: Canary passed, metrics stable. Promote in 5 unless objections.

alex: Promoting now, gradual ramp 5%->100% over 6min.

rn-bot: Release notes draft: billing-service 3.1.0 (CRD change + migration). Manual migration applied, canary 5%->100%, smoke tests passed. Links attached.

ops-jen: Closing thread. Follow-up: deploy-bot enhancement request to detect missing migration job earlier in CI.
